articles.title: UAE air defences intercept "incoming missiles and drones from Iran": Defence Ministry
articles.summary: The UAE Ministry of Defence confirmed its national air defences are intercepting incoming missiles and drones. These threats are reportedly originating from Iran, indicating a significant security engagement. This incident highlights regional tensions and the critical role of air defence systems in national security, a key area of study for SSB aspirants tracking international defence developments.

articles.title: Iran says can fight for months as Israel strikes Beirut hotel
articles.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards have declared their forces capable of sustaining an intense six-month war against the United States and Israel. This statement follows recent escalations, including an alleged Israeli strike on Iranian commanders. The declaration underscores significant geopolitical tensions and the potential for prolonged conflict involving Iran, the US, and Israel, highlighting ongoing instability in the Middle East.
